title: Add packaged Bronze ingestion with versioned source parsers
body:
Adds an installable `budget` application package with local Bronze ingestion. Importing a declared `danske-csv-v1` file retains its exact bytes and provenance in SQLite, presents source fields unchanged, and records repeat imports, account conflicts, coverage refusals, and format failures.

Parsing lives behind an explicit source-format registry under `src/budget/bronze/parsers/`. Encoding, layout, date syntax and filename conventions belong to the versioned parser; persistence and coverage rules stay source-independent. The package builds as a wheel and sdist and needs no runtime dependencies or `PYTHONPATH` setup.

Test directories follow application responsibilities, and test files describe observable behavior. Tests are organized by responsibility: `tests/bronze/parsers/test_danske_csv_v1.py` covers the format through its public parser methods, `tests/bronze/parsers/test_registry.py` covers registry selection, and `tests/bronze/test_store.py` covers persistence and representative real-parser integration. Exhaustive format cases live in the parser suite; the store retains byte/provenance, replay, refusal, coverage and legacy-cache checks.

This incorporates main's #44 quality configuration unchanged. The implementation and tests pass its Ruff lint/format, ty, and complexity gates without new suppressions. Plans, checkpoints and execution reports are excluded from the PR; the README and source-parser guide contain the durable setup and extension guidance. There are no workflow changes relative to main.

Validation:
- Locked `uv sync`; Ruff lint and format, ty and complexipy all pass; 23 tests pass through both unittest discovery and pytest.
- Wheel and sdist installed separately into fresh environments outside the checkout; public store import, source-file deletion, database reopen and source-data retrieval succeed with `PYTHONPATH` cleared.
- Regression coverage preserves the previous parser's accepted date syntax and unchanged raw fields. Baseline comparisons cover 17 transaction-date values and nine filenames.

Current scope is local file ingestion and one implemented CSV format. Nordea formats, bank API acquisition, nested API records, multi-format cache scoping, and a CLI remain future work; the parser guide identifies the contracts those additions need.
